query_text: which came first the walking dead comic or show

messages.content: which came first the walking dead comic or show

message.content:
The **comic** came first. *The Walking Dead* comic debuted in **2003**, while the TV show premiered in **2010**.[1][4]

The show was **based on the comic**, not the other way around.[4]
